about: Hand decisions about MX1 stat blocks that scripts/msh/roster.py applies after parsing (scripts/msh/gridbooks.py reads this book). Every one was read off the page image by the survey (apps/marvel-heroes/docs/surveys/mx1.md, Stat blocks; decisions 4 and 5); none is a guess from OCR.
Facts only - numbers, rank codes and a few words of a label - so this file is committed while roster.json stays in the local cache.
match     {page, header}: the printed page in the Adventure Book, and the start of the entry's header
verdict   misprint    the book prints a value its own arithmetic contradicts; 'printed' keeps what the page says, 'corrected' what the rules give
as_printed  the page is unambiguous and the check still fails; kept as printed, and the note says why
match     {row}: a text verdict's msh_book_text row key instead

text        a mark in the prose only the page image settles: 'read' is the few words as the chain reads them, 'printed' as the page prints them; scripts/msh/npcs.py stops if 'read' is not found exactly once in its row
also      further values of the same block, each {verdict, field, printed, and corrected for a misprint}: one override matches one block, and a block can print more than one thing to explain
checked   the date the page image was read

overrides.note: A robot: printed Karma = 0, Resources = 0 and Popularity = 0, with R, I and P printed (6 Ty each), so Karma = R+I+P cannot hold. MA1 prints - for the same machines.
A robot, as the Mark IV: printed Karma = 0 with R 10 Gd, I 6 Ty and P 6 Ty.
A robot, as the Mark IV: printed Karma = 0 with R 10 Gd, I 10 Gd and P 6 Ty.
A robot, as the Mark IV: printed Karma = 0 with R 20 Ex, I 10 Gd and P 10 Gd.
A robot, as the Mark IV: printed Karma = 0 with R 30 Rm, I 20 Ex and P 10 Gd.
Printed R 30 Ex, I 30 Gd and P 10 Gy. Karma 70 = 30 + 30 + 10 holds on the numbers, 30 is Remarkable and 10 Good, and Gy is no code; MA1 (p.81) prints R 30 Rm, I 30 Rm and P 10 Gd.

Printed S Ty (4), R Ex (6) and I Ty (8), Health 22 and Karma 32. Health 22 = 4 + 6 + 6 + 6 and Karma 32 = 20 + 6 + 6 hold on her codes' standard numbers and on no reading that keeps the printed numbers (they give Health 20 and Karma 20), so the numbers are the misprint.

Printed S Ty (4) and I Ty (8), the same pairs as Timbre Morava's, resolving the other way: Health 44 = 10 + 10 + 4 + 20 and Karma 18 = 4 + 8 + 6 hold on the numbers and fail on Typical's 6, so the codes are the misprint. 4 is Poor; 8 is inside Good's range (8-15) and not its standard, kept here rather than as a rank_ranges for the book (survey decision 5).

A codes-only grid: R Pr, I Ty and P Pr give Karma 4 + 6 + 4 = 14, and its Health 28 holds on the same codes. 16 would hold if either Pr were Ty, and nothing on the page says which, so the codes are kept and the Karma corrected (survey decision 4).
Printed 10, the narrow column beside the map, Gas Jets: the OCR lost the line between Remarkable and areas altogether (seen on a 300 dpi crop of PDF 12).
Printed 10, the same column, Customization: the line between special and equipment is lost the same way (same crop).
Printed 9, column 3, Cold Beams: the capital I of its first word read as a vertical bar (seen on a 300 dpi crop of PDF 11).
Printed 13, column 3, Automatic Escape: the capital I of its first word read as a backslash (seen on a 300 dpi crop of PDF 15).
